thread:
maria: Heads-up: 5 users in prod saw other users' RBAC after SSO login. Happened across two tenants. Investigating now.
kevin: Any SAML logs? assertion_id or relaystate odd?
maria: Seeing same assertion_id used for different post-auth sessions — looks like assertion reuse. RelayState present but maps to different session sometimes.
ida: Wait — did we recently rotate signing key in KMS? We rotated idp-signer last night.
jordan: We did. Rotation at 02:17 UTC; okta accepted new cert. Could the gateway be caching assertions on http2 connection?
maria: Auth-proxy uses http2 multiplexing to IDP — suspicion: connection reuse causing response stream mismatch and assertion from previous request applied.
kevin: Repro steps?
maria: In staging: run `ab -n 20 -c 5` hitting /sso/callback with parallel logins — sometimes relaystate get swapped. I'll drop logs.
ida: Add assertion_id and subject in audit logs. We need to trace assertion -> sessionID mapping. Current audit only logs userID after session create.
jordan: Quick mitigation: force `Connection: close` from proxy to IDP so no stream reuse. Can we patch and hotfix?
maria: Can do a quick canary in prod on one LB. Also add a check: require assertion_id nonce uniqueness server-side for 1 minute.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: rolling update auth-proxy to revision r2026.3.1785 on prod-lb-3
kevin: Also check KMS rotation logs: maybe old cert signatures still validated due to idp clock skew? But assertion reuse seems more likely.
ida: Agreed. But KMS logs show a rewrap event 02:17 with no errors. I'll verify signature headers in SAML response: `Signature` element uses new key?
maria: Logs show both `Signature` using new key. No sig failures. So not signing bug.
jordan: Patch landed to set Connection: close on canary LB. Monitoring login entitlements for 30m.
maria: After canary, no repro in 45m. We'll roll forward and add nonce check. Filing follow-up to implement assertion cache and audit fields.
maria: Follow-up action items:
- kevin add assertion_id+subject to audit logs (PR #1234)
- ida confirm KMS rotation validation logs
- jordan roll auth-proxy to all LBs
- maria write runbook entry and notify compliance
- set up alert if assertion reuse detected

anita: Should we notify impacted tenants? Compliance leaning towards disclosure. How many users affected?
maria: 6 users, 2 tenants. No elevated privileges observed. We should notify CS and customers via security note. Drafting message.
kevin: :thumbsup: good call. Also add a regression test for parallel SSO flows in ci.
maria: Done. Closing thread after rollout and customer comms. Thanks everyone :heart:
